title: Ghilli
desc: An aspiring kabaddi player travels to Madurai to participate in a regional match, where he rescues Dhanalakshmi from Muthupandi, a powerful man who wants to marry the girl against her will.

title: Ratsasan
desc: Following his father's death, a man gives up on his dream to become a film-maker and joins the police force. He then attempts to track down a psychopathic killer who targets schoolgirls.

title: Vrithra
desc: Cop Indra Rao is overwhelmed by a series of disturbing evidence regarding a seemingly open-and-shut case. Following the clues, she must choose one, the truth or her career.

title: Rise of Jurassic
desc: A pilot who is patrolling the coast, crash-lands on an island and discovers that it is inhabited by dinosaurs. Later, the pilot discovers secrets related to the island and dinosaurs.

title: Kochi Rajavu
desc: Tragedy strikes when Unni accidentally kills his lover's cousin, resulting in his imprisonment.

title: Avane Srimannarayana
desc: Narayana attempts to solve the mystery behind the treasure that has gone missing. However, Jayaram, a gang leader, places several obstacles in his way.
